name: Missing outbox after completed session pauses
goal: If native session logs show a completed agent turn but no outbox appears, v2 relay must pause for user attention.

workspace_files.README.md:
# Missing Outbox Safety Net

Session completion without outbox must pause rather than infer content.

context: This scenario is primarily synthetic. The session log will show an end_turn/final_answer completion without an outbox file. The correct result is missing_outbox_after_turn:<agent> and no auto-import.
